title: How is Hitler linked to Taylor Swift?
hook: Hitler to Taylor Swift. Here's how.
description: Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Taylor Swift: Romania's dictator and its young king, a Kremlin Victory Day, cheeseburgers with Obama, and Meryl Streep's Medal of Freedom.
fun_fact: In 1944, King Michael had Ion Antonescu arrested and switched Romania to the Allies, and Moscow later gave him the Soviet Order of Victory.
research_note: Taylor Swift's free photos with famous people are rare, so the route ends at The Giver's 2014 premiere with Meryl Streep instead of the press photo of Prince William's 2013 gala; Romania's King Michael, who lived until 2017, carries it from the war to 2010.

links.line: In the 1940s, Hitler hosted his ally, Romania's dictator Ion Antonescu.
In 1941, Antonescu stood at the front beside Romania's young King Michael.
In 2010, an elderly King Michael visited Russia's Dmitry Medvedev at the Kremlin.

image.file: File:Dmitry Medvedev in the United States 24 June 2010-10.jpeg

links.line: That year, Barack Obama took Medvedev out for cheeseburgers in Virginia.

image.file: File:Barack Obama presents the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Meryl Streep November 2014.jpg

links.line: In 2014, Obama gave Meryl Streep the Presidential Medal of Freedom.

image.file: File:The cast of The Giver August 2014.jpg

links.line: And in 2014, Streep's co-star at The Giver's premiere was Taylor Swift.
